task.title: Historical decisions from an earlier relayfile#478 repair branch

events.content: Chose step-environment release inputs and per-job GitHub permissions

raw.question: How should custom release inputs and GitHub permissions be scoped?
raw.chosen: Pass release inputs through step env and scope permissions per job
raw.reasoning: Direct expression interpolation could turn a custom version into shell source, while workflow-wide write permissions exceeded build and publish needs.

events.content: Chose attestation-before-tag and parent/tree equivalence for retries

raw.question: How should release tag retries be constrained?
raw.chosen: Generate attestation before remote tag push and require parent/tree equivalence for reuse
raw.reasoning: A retry can regenerate a different commit object for the same intended release; proving the immutable source parent and exact release tree allows safe reuse without tagging un-attested code.
